text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oh, despite a bit of trouble before the start,
Agnes Agnes is all right!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama 2000m, the path has been paved.
Agnes Tachyon takes the first crown!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, 'First crown down'... I wonder. But well, good enough for today.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Dammit...! I made a total blunder!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The turning point of the match was—the start.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
W-What could be the matter?
Agnes Tachyon is taking quite a while
to enter the gate.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "She isn't normally an Umamusume who shows this kind of hesitation, but..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(What's the matter, Tachyon?
Getting cold feet at this point, or...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Whoa, shoot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's uncharacteristic behavior
ended up throwing Jungle Pocket
completely off her focus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she regained her focus, it was already too late.
2,000 meters was far too short
to recover her lost rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon, there's something I need to tell you.
Today, not yet—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: This is just the beginning!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The beginning—what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to deciding who stands at the top—the leader of our generation—
it's undeniably the next race, the Nippon Derby."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat you at the very pinnacle!
Only by doing that can I be the strongest of our generation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... I see. Well, that makes sense.
I want that too, after all. To beat you in the Derby.
Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Being defeated, that is.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Beaten?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. However, light converges where it ought
to converge. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's the end of a beginning, and the start of the next.
See you, Pokke-kun.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't get this at all...
Hey, Tachyon! You'd better brace yourself!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I'll damn well show 'em at the Japanese Derby.
The roar of the demon, my most terrifying run!"
